evidence: No email found. Systems Science & Complexity, arXiv math.OC), a biomedical co-author (PLOS ONE, Tongji/LSU), a materials-science author (npj Computational Materials), and an MIT ballroom-dance competitor. The MDPI page, doi.org, researchgate.net and the PDF host res.mdpi.com are all egress-blocked in this container, so the author-email block could not be read directly.
